fields.name: count
fields.desc: number of records

desc: Extra enemy units injected into an existing map by a quest (Quest.quest_enemy_group -> group). Bytes 616..1207 are one 592-byte map-unit record, the same structure used in Map/mapNNNNN/mapNNNNN.chr (u16 count @0 + 16-byte header, then N*592): char_id, level, direction, position, equipment, 20 evilities, 20 skills (+levels). Adding a custom boss to any stage without editing map files: new QuestEnemy rows (group G, map M) + Quest row with cond_type 4, cond_target1 M, quest_enemy_group G.

fields.name: id
fields.desc: row id 1..107

fields.name: group
fields.desc: quest enemy group; Quest.quest_enemy_group selects all rows of a group (15 groups: 1,5..18)

fields.name: map_id
fields.desc: map the units are added to (= dungeon.map_id; equals the Quest cond_target1 of the owning quest)

fields.name: name_JP
fields.desc: unit display name (e.g. "Gallatin"); empty = use class name

fields.name: title_JP
fields.desc: unit title/epithet (e.g. "Evil God Disciple")

fields.name: unk_264
fields.desc: always 0

fields.name: unit_index
fields.desc: placement index (== id here); first field of the 592-byte map-unit record also used in Map/mapNNNNN.chr (16-byte header + N*592)

fields.name: char_id

fields.name: level
fields.desc: unit level (3..3300 here)

fields.name: direction
